paper_title: Axion Dark Matter eXperiment around 3.3 μeV with Dine-Fischler-Srednicki-Zhitnitsky Discovery Ability
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on y-axis
notes: ADMX haloscope excludes DFSZ axion-photon coupling over 3.27-3.34 ueV (792-807 MHz) at 90% CL, standard halo model rho=0.45 GeV/cm^3. Numerical limit values not tabulated; the exclusion reaches the DFSZ line (~1.4e-16 GeV^-1 at these masses, estimated from Fig. 4 y-axis 1e-16 to 1e-15 and DFSZ benchmark). Endpoints given at the stated mass range.
